from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge

Many thanks, I cannot be quite sure about Luise but if she is not used within a year, she shall be returned

C M Yonge[^1]


[^1]: A postcard addressed to \'Mrs Lynch/ West End Hotel/ San Remo/ Italy\' and postmarked Winchester 4 November 1890. [Mrs Lynch](/person/2437) may be the E. M. Lynch who had previously contributed to MP.
